Bright hello weekend crew,
The day planner sent an update on traveler questions and I want us tight on handling. We had a steady mix of carrier checks, last-minute gate notes, and a few calls that needed clean handoffs between the desk and the ramp. Keep the ledger current, flag any service changes as soon as they land, and make sure the language we use stays calm and practical for everyone involved. The cabin team and ground team both need the same facts, no drift, no extra chatter.

For Cloudrest, <<FACT F040>> please slot it into the day notes where it belongs and keep the rest of the handoff simple. If a traveler asks for a status update, use the approved wording and avoid adding anything that has not already been confirmed. For Windmere, <<FACT F053>> and keep that detail aligned with the boarding record before the flight is closed out. If a pet needs a care check or a carrier move, the desk should see it in the log first, then the team can act without delay.

Keep an eye on Maya Silva and Sana Moretti if their filings come back across the queue, and make sure any mention of Gus stays matched to the right trip record. We are running this as one shared service, so the cleanest work is the work that disappears into the process and leaves the traveler with a smooth day. Please keep the pace brisk, the notes clear, and the tone friendly. Companion Animal Travel Desk
